title: Co-Stars: my Epic AI MegaJam game
author: anotherbuilddev
selftext:
just finished the epic ai megajam. made a 2 seat co-op starfighter game on a 70s film set in 4 days, solo, with ai agents.

hats off to every dev who has finished a game jam. it is a ton of work and i felt a LOT of pressure the whole time. and i’m sure it would have been way harder doing even a smaller game without ai, so real respect to everyone who ships these.

some numbers if you like that stuff: about 990 messages, 22k words (nearly a short novel, all of it notes), about 800 decisions. the agents did the typing.

last devlog (the human side + what is the point of ai game dev): [https://youtu.be/vKMornG\_QD4](https://youtu.be/vKMornG_QD4)  
trailer: [https://youtu.be/ZAJ6Ew-yMDc](https://youtu.be/ZAJ6Ew-yMDc)  
all the devlogs: [https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLHDbhPA6zytY](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLHDbhPA6zytY)

comments.author: YoungandPregnant
comments.body: This looks quite good actually, I can’t really see evidence of AI slop. The only slop I saw was the comic text for like CHAIN! Or POW!

replies.author: anotherbuilddev
replies.body: Thanks mate, I definitely put a bunch of time into this one and wanted to try to put something together that felt a little more original than most.

comments.author: Aeweisafemalesheep
comments.body: So it's a game jam. What new stuff was done and how?

replies.author: anotherbuilddev
replies.body:
Thanks for asking, I have not seen this stuff before personally but maybe some other games have done them:

\- a really fluid set up for co-op gunner (or gunner while the AI flies) and hot swapping between roles   
\- a different take on a boss fight in a space fighter game  
\- a rewind system is a space fighter  
\- a game that features a 70s campy sci fi theme  
\- and a ton of things you might notice if you play the game through 4 fully playable, fun, and diverse levels

Is that the sort of stuff you are looking for?
